newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends firm on commercial buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends firm on commercial buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly higher, with March gaining against CBOT March on strong commercial buying, traders said.
"Commercial buying and scale-up pricing is the story today," one trader said.
Some of the strength was tied to a lack of hedge-related selling because of the snow and cold temperatures that have paralyzed grain movement in the northern U.S. Plains.
MGE spring wheat closed 2-1/2 cents per bushel lower to five cents higher, with Dec down 2-1/2 cents at $4.24-1/2. March gained five cents to close at $3.94.

In recent days, MGE March spring wheat had weakened relative to CBOT March wheat. But players reversed that pattern Tuesday, buying March in Minneapolis and selling it in Chicago. In all, the MGE contract gained almost seven cents on its Chicago counterpart Tuesday.
Traders said Country Hedging bought at least two million March bushels and sold one million March. Benson-Quinn bought 1.3 million March and LFG sold one million March.
MGE barley futures closed three cents per cwt lower to one cent higher, with March down three cents at $6.52.
